quiz_name: Quiz 3: Game SDLC, UI Controls, and Container Layouts! 🖥️💡

questions.q: What does SDLC stand for in game and software engineering?
questions.exp: SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) represents the structured steps developers follow from initial concept to release!

questions.q: Which phase of the SDLC is dedicated to brainstorming initial features, story settings, and game play themes?
questions.exp: Idea Generation is the very first golden phase, hosting brainstorming sessions to establish rules, characters, and gameplay!

questions.q: Why is the Prototyping phase crucial during game development?
opts: To sell the game to players immediately
To build a quick, simple test version of gameplay mechanics to verify if the core idea is fun
questions.exp: A prototype lets developers test simple mechanics quickly, ensuring the game is engaging before investing effort in art and code!

questions.q: What do we call the SDLC phase where developers play the game repeatedly to hunt and resolve bugs?
questions.exp: The Testing phase is where playtesters hunt down errors, visual glitches, and bugs to ensure a smooth, stable experience!

questions.q: What is UI (User Interface) in games?
opts: The code that controls physics gravity
The visual layer (scores, buttons, health) that lets players interact with and read game info
questions.exp: User Interface (UI) is the presentation layer consisting of health bars, buttons, and scores that lets players communicate with the game!

questions.q: Which Godot UI node is used specifically to render and display static or dynamic texts like 'Score: 50'?
questions.exp: The Label node displays any text sentences, scores, or titles on the screen for players to view!

questions.q: Which UI node is used to receive mouse click interactions to start levels or open panels?
questions.exp: The Button node triggers pressed signals when clicked, allowing players to launch games, select options, or buy upgrades!

questions.q: Which UI node allows players to type in customized text strings like entering their custom hero name?
questions.exp: The LineEdit node provides a text entry box where players can type names, inputs, or secret cheat codes!

questions.q: What is the primary function of Container nodes like VBoxContainer in Godot?
opts: To automatically align and organize child UI controls vertically (above each other)
To move paddles up and down
questions.exp: VBoxContainer stands for Vertical Box Container, which aligns all child buttons and labels neatly in a vertical column!

questions.q: Which container aligns child controls horizontally side-by-side in a neat row?
questions.exp: HBoxContainer stands for Horizontal Box Container, which arranges buttons or icons side-by-side in a row!
